What Your Customers See First.

Unfortunately, your new targeted audience probably does not know much about you. Before they know about your business’s goals or mission, they see the label, or that flyer for your event. My purpose is to show off what makes your business special in the form of an eye-catching graphic.
HOW I WORK

My Working Process

Consultation

We will start off having a conversation about your goals and designs that you like.

Mock-up

I will then go to the drawing board and show you a few different ideas so we are on the same page.

Review

You will have time here to choose your favorite mockup, together we will edit and shape the design.

Production

After we have completed all edits, all files will be turned over to you for printing.

Brand Consistency

It is extremely important that all your designs look the same! Think about every major brand you have ever interacted with, Target, Walmart, Apple all of them have the same feel in their stores and marketing. Just because you are probably not as large does not mean you cannot have access to the same strategies. Even a wedding can maintain brand consistency and so can you.

Partnerships & Speed

Being a small business owner myself I know how nice it is to be able to pick up the phone and cross an item off my to-do list. The most important things are getting problems solved and speed, the faster the flyers get back to you the faster you can start marketing and the more people you can reach. I aim to empower you in the most effective ways possible.

Social Media

Your brand does not just stop with physical prints, in this day and age if you are not online you are missing access to roughly 4.4 billion people. That’s a lot of possible customers if you only get .0001% that is still 440,000 people! I offer services to help market to these people. My services range from taking over all of your accounts for you, writing content, creating post, and posting. To taking your words and creating the graphics for you to post on your own time.

You Do Not Have To Know Anything About Development.

No matter the size of your website, I’m here to help develop it. WordPress development doesn’t have to be hard. I build everything with you in mind, making it easy to manage all your content.

  • Prioritize the features your customers need
  • Align everyone around the roadmap
  • Define your product vision with customer feedback
Spend less time worrying about getting online and more time getting back to building your business. We help you with the best tools you need to best communicate your idea.
HOW I WORK

My Working Process

Consultation

What are your goals for the site? What is important to your visitors? Is speed more important than a lot of features?

Build

Time to take your design and create a site that you can manage yourself. I pride myself on building sites with speed and efficiency.

Review

There are always things to tweak, we plan for these changes by giving you time to sit back all edits during this phase are Free!

Maintain

How will you handle software updates and adjust for hackers? I make it easy so once we are done you never have to think about your site again.

My development process is tried and tested

My process has been carefully crafted since 2012. I code with you in mind. Whether you want to update and maintain your own site or work with me so you can “set it and forget it”, together we will make the process both fun and easy.

Lean Effective Code

The benefits of lean code are countless. For starters, it’s easier to build additional features in the future. Secondly is faster load time, visitors who have to wait longer than 4 seconds for a webpage to load leave, is your site fast enough?

Built In Mobile Ready

With 88.6% of United States users accessing the internet via their smartphones, it has never been more important for your website to be usable on mobile. Not only is it important for your visitors but having a solid mobile ready site will also increase your ranking on google.

Deliver Measurable Results

I develop to your needs! The first thing we will do together is write out what success looks like. This will become our road map so you always know what I am working on and where we are in the process to launch.

Marketing for Your Small Business

Here we will build everything the users interact with on the site. Starting from your specific brand identity (colors, imagery, mood) and build a website your users find intuitive to use and you find easy to maintain.

A good marketing service is focused on one thing—results. Our focus is never on “sugar-high” results from blindly overspending on ads and flash promos, but on strategic, sustainable results that gain momentum over time. That’s why we start each marketing service with a kick-off call guided with the goal of ensuring I understand your goals for your small business. From there, we map a tailored plan with transparent performance reporting every month so you see meaningful progress toward your goals each step of the way.
HOW WE DO IT

My Working Process

Kick off Call

We will have an initial call to discuss your goals and the types of engagement you are looking for.

Research

Then I will go and learn all about your preferred customers, where they spend their free time and what convinces them to take action.

Planning

A written plan will then be constructed with measurable results with edits from you to ensure we are on the same page.

Engagement

Now with our plan in hand we will implement it while constantly checking to make sure we are meeting our previously agreed results.

Create A Tailored Plan

Together we will create an easy-to-understand marketing plan that is tailored to your business. Each plan is tailored to your budget to maximize the value of your dollars.

Transparent Reporting

You can propel your business forward: we deliver enterprise IT services through leadership, technology and solutions across business applications, data insights, cloud advancement.

Flexible Service

Complete freedom to change or cancel your marketing service at any time and an option to work together on a project-to-project basis if that setup better fits your needs.

Dedicated Service Manager

Unlike working with a firm where you may have 3 or 4 different points of contact. I am a single point of contact who will ensure your plan is reached and handle any coordinating for you. You can simply reach out to me any time with updates, questions or to just say hi!

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

I notice some similar questions I get. If these do not answer yours please email me.

How much does a website cost?

As much as I would like to this question simply, there is no thumb rule as to what a website should cost. It will certainly depend on project requirements, features, and inclusions to say the least. Some websites that are less complex will incur a different cost than a website that has some custom features and integrations. A fully customized website with in-depth custom features and integrations including e-commerce will incur higher cost. We will have a detailed conversation to discuss your needs and provide the right quote.

Where are you located?

I am based about 30 minutes outside of Washington D.C at the moment, however I have clients based in just about every state. Thanks to online portals like Zoom and Google Meet I can be available to you any time from 9 a.m. (est) to 8 p.m. (est).

What tools do you use to create websites?

I can create your website with most tools from Squarespace to React & Node.Js. Most commonly I will create with WordPress or Webflow because they are great content management systems that my clients find easy to use and update.

When do I pay?

For most projects, equal payments are made at the start,and again at the end of the project, but I can work with you to set up a schedule that meets your needs. Websites can be a big investment and I want to help you budget for the expense in whatever way possible. I accept checks, PayPal, and all major credit cards.

Who writes the content for the site?

You are the expert on your business, so it’s usually best if it comes from you. If you need help, I can recommend copywriters who can help clean up or write original content for you at an additional cost.

Where should I host my website?

There are lots of options but I host all of my clients. This is for a very simple reason. If something ever happens there are no delays. If you host with GoDaddy for example and we need to edit the server I will spend a lot of time on the phone talking to a rep from a data center. The whole time your site is down. By hosting with me, we have total control over everything.

What if I need help on my site down the road?

I am only an email away! I am here to help you as much or as little as you need, and I do not disappear once the site is launched. I have been doing this for a long time and prefer to build long lasting relationships with my clients. I am going anywhere anytime soon.

How much input do I have in the process?

A Ton! Throughout each part of the process I am constantly looking for feedback. Before a line of code is written, I will send you a mockup of the homepage design so you can see exactly what I am thinking before we get started. My rule is no surprises.

Will I be able to update the site myself when it’s finished?

Yes! I love it when my clients take control of their website and learn to manage it on their own. I will provide you with a set of comprehensive video tutorials to help you learn your way around, as well provide you with a training session to help get you on your way. (Note: Feel free to sent me questions I love to answer them!)

Will you maintain my site for me?

Yes I can! We can talk about how you would like your site to evolve over time. I have some clients who only want me to make sure their security is up to date and maintain updates. Others send me a word doc each week and I make sure their blog is updated and update pages as needed. Whatever your needs are, we can make a custom plan for you!

Let’s Start Working Together. Get in Touch with Us!

High Standards

Focus on People

I want each of my clients to feel like they are getting a high quality experience with a tool they can use to further their goals. Websites can be a lot like cars. When they are well built they can be absolute head turners that become an important part of your everyday life. When they are poorly built or maintained they become expensive junk that is broken down and useless.

I want your website to be easy and helpful. Something you cant imagine not having access to in your day to day business.
Making a website look pretty is easy. Everyone has used cool websites with awesome animations and pretty colors, but the end user can not find the buy now button, or the contact phone number.

I create websites for people. I want your end user to be able to find what they are looking for quickly. I want you to find updating your website to be a quick and easy experience. I take time to consider things such as “how does this website load for a blind person?” I create websites that are effective and consider the humans who use them.

Everyone in the marketing industry always hides how they work (google other people and check). I break everything down into 3 large milestones that you can understand with several smaller sub-goals built into each one.

Build our Funnel that Connects Everything

Got Questions? I am a real life human! Text Me + 240 331 - 6612

This is the reason I have structured my services in the manner that I have. I handle all your digital concerns for you. If you need to ever update your website, just send an email and its done, no more having to worry about what you are going to post on social media or why 1 post has 20 likes and another has 3.
